data.mechanism: The same adaptor, TAX1BP1, can bring ULK1 instead of TBK1 to stressed lysosomes; either kinase then phosphorylates FNIP1.
data.mechanism_beginner: TAX1BP1 can bring ULK1 to the lysosome instead of TBK1.
data.context: Conditional on lysosomal stress, not on nutrients, exactly as for TBK1 (TAX1BP1-TBK1). The two kinases are drawn as alternatives on the same adaptor because ESP2026 reports both as competent to phosphorylate FNIP1 at S296, and nothing in it establishes a division of labour between them: which one dominates in which cell type, under which kind of lysosomal stress, and whether they are redundant or additive, is untested (question H11). Treat the pair as one route with two possible kinases rather than two independently established routes.
data.boundary: One study in human cell lines (ESP2026). Which kinase dominates in which cell type is not stated in the abstract. Full text not accessible when this link was written.
